newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-INDIA LOSE TOSS, FIELD VS S.AFRICA A.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA LOSE TOSS, FIELD VS S.AFRICA A.

text.p: Souh African A skipper John Commins won the toss and elected to bat in the one-day match against India in Pietermaritzburg on Thursday.
South Africa A - Gerhardus Liebenberg, Piet Botha, Louis Koen, Herschelle Gibbs, John Commins (captain), Derek Crookes, Mark Boucher, Nicky Boje, Ross Veenstra, Makhaya Ntini, Wayne Kidwell.
India - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Rahul Dravid, Ajay Jadeja, Robin Singh, Salil Ankola, Venkatesh Prasad, Nayan Mongia, Vikram Rathore, Doda Ganesh, Pankaj Dharmani, Sunil Joshi.
